item.description: Chrysanthemums are among the most beloved cut flowers and garden staples across India. item.title: Village growing food for elephants
item.description: #thebetterindia Once feared, chased, and hated, the elephants of Assam’s Hatikhuli now walk peacefully through farms — thanks to a simple, extraordinary idea: feed, don’t fight. item.title: 'My Dad Saved for My Education Instead of Dowry; He Stood by Me & Changed My Life'
item.description: The town in Bihar where I grew up witnessed girls my age being married right after Class 10. It was customary for fathers to set aside money for their dowry. But, I had different dreams. And so my father invested that same money into my education. Things were not always easy as we lived in a kaccha (makeshift) house.
